plain.headline: Full of Grace
plain.intro: Today we celebrate that God kept Mary free from original sin from the very first moment of her life in her mother's womb, by a special grace given through her Son Jesus, the Savior. Genesis tells how sin entered the world and how God promised victory over the serpent through the woman's offspring. Paul praises God for choosing us in Christ to be holy, and in the Gospel the angel greets Mary as full of grace, and she says yes to God.
plain.listen: how the angel greets Mary before he tells her anything else

Reading 1.box: After Adam and Eve eat the forbidden fruit, God comes looking for them, and each one blames someone else. God curses the serpent and promises lasting hostility between the serpent and the woman, and between their offspring. The Church has long read this promise as the first announcement of the Savior, and sees in the woman a sign of Mary, the new Eve.

chunks.text: The Lord God called to the man, "Where are you?" He answered, "I heard you in the garden and I was afraid, because I was naked. So I hid."

God asked, "Who told you that you were naked? Did you eat from the tree I told you not to eat from?" The man said, "The woman you gave me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it." Then the Lord God asked the woman, "What have you done?" She said, "The serpent tricked me, and I ate."

The Lord God said to the serpent, "Because you did this, you are cursed more than any other animal. You will crawl on your belly and eat dust all your life. I will make you and the woman enemies, and your offspring and hers. He will strike your head, and you will strike his heel."
The man named his wife Eve, because she would become the mother of all the living.

Responsorial Psalm.box: The psalm calls everyone to sing a new song, because God has done wonderful things and has shown his saving power to every nation. He has kept his loving promise to Israel, so the whole earth should shout for joy.

Reading 2.box: Paul praises God, who chose us in Christ before the world was made, to be holy and blameless and to become his children. Everything God does serves his loving plan, and our lives are meant to give him glory. On this feast the Church sees these words fulfilled in a unique way in Mary, whom God made holy from the very start.

chunks.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. In Christ he has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in heaven. Before the world was made, he chose us in Christ to be holy and blameless before him in love.
Out of his love and goodwill, he planned long ago to adopt us as his children through Jesus Christ. He did this so we would praise his glorious grace, the grace he freely gave us in his beloved Son.

In Christ we have also received an inheritance. God planned this from the beginning, for he carries out everything according to his will. He did it so that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would live for the praise of his glory.

Gospel.box: God sends the angel Gabriel to Mary in Nazareth to ask her to become the mother of his Son. Mary is troubled and asks how this can be, and then she gives herself fully to God's plan. This Gospel tells of Jesus' conception; today's feast celebrates Mary's own conception, years earlier, in the womb of her mother.

chunks.text: In the sixth month, God sent the angel Gabriel to a town in Galilee called Nazareth. He was sent to a virgin engaged to a man named Joseph, a descendant of King David. The virgin's name was Mary.

The angel came to her and said, "Rejoice, you who are full of grace. The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women." Mary was deeply troubled by his words and wondered what this greeting could mean.

The angel said, "Do not be afraid, Mary. God has shown you his favor. You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you will name him Jesus. He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his ancestor David. He will rule over the house of Jacob forever, and his Kingdom will never end."

Mary asked the angel, "How can this be, since I am a virgin?" The angel answered, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the holy child born of you will be called the Son of God.

Your relative Elizabeth, who was said to be unable to have children, has also conceived a son in her old age. She is now in her sixth month. Nothing is impossible for God." Mary said, "I am the servant of the Lord. Let it be done to me as you have said." Then the angel left her.

plain.carry: Like Mary, this week I will answer God's call with a simple yes, trusting that his grace is enough for whatever he asks.

kids.headline: Mary, Full of Grace
kids.intro: Today is a special feast of Mary, and a holy day when Catholics go to Mass. We celebrate that from the very first moment Mary began to live, inside her own mother, God kept her free from original sin, the sin everyone else is born with. God gave her this gift because of Jesus, who would one day be her Son.
kids.listen: the special greeting the angel gives Mary

Reading 1.box: This reading tells what happened right after Adam and Eve disobeyed God. God promises that one day the snake who tricked them will be beaten by a child of the woman. The Church sees Jesus in that child and Mary in that woman.

chunks.text: God called to the man, "Where are you?" The man said, "I heard you, and I was scared because I had no clothes on, so I hid." God asked, "Who told you that you had no clothes on? Did you eat from the tree I told you not to eat from?" The man blamed the woman: "She gave me the fruit, and I ate it." God asked the woman, "What did you do?" She blamed the snake: "The snake tricked me, and I ate."

God said to the snake, "Because you did this, you are cursed. You will crawl on your belly and eat dust. You and the woman will be enemies, and so will your children and hers. Her child will strike your head, and you will strike his heel." The man named his wife Eve, because she would be the mother of all people.

Responsorial Psalm.box: This is a happy song. It asks everyone on earth to sing a new song to God, because he has done wonderful things and saved his people.

Reading 2.box: Saint Paul thanks God for choosing us to be his children, even before he made the world. God wants us to be holy and to live for him. God chose Mary in a very special way and made her holy from the very beginning.

chunks.text: Let us praise God, the Father of Jesus. Through Jesus he has given us every blessing from heaven. Before he even made the world, he chose us to be holy and to love him. Because he loves us, he planned for us to become his own children through Jesus.

We praise God for the wonderful gift he gave us in Jesus, his beloved Son. God planned everything, and he gave us a share in all that belongs to his family. He did all this so that we, who hope in Jesus, would praise him with our lives.

Gospel.box: God sends the angel Gabriel to a young woman named Mary to ask her to be the mother of Jesus, and Mary says yes. This story is about how Jesus began to grow inside Mary. Today's feast is about something that happened years earlier, when Mary's own life began free from original sin.

chunks.text: God sent the angel Gabriel to a town called Nazareth. He went to a young woman named Mary, who was promised in marriage to a man named Joseph. The angel said, "Rejoice, you who are full of grace. The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women." Mary was surprised and a little worried, and she wondered what the angel meant.

The angel said, "Do not be afraid, Mary. God is very pleased with you. You will have a baby boy, and you will name him Jesus. He will be great, and he will be called the Son of the Most High God. He will be a king forever, and his Kingdom will never end."

Mary asked, "How can this happen? I have no husband." The angel said, "The Holy Spirit will come to you, and God's power will cover you like a shadow. So your baby will be holy, and he will be called the Son of God. Your relative Elizabeth, who people thought could never have a baby, is going to have a baby too, even though she is old. Nothing is impossible for God." Mary said, "I am the Lord's servant. Let it happen as you have said." Then the angel left.

word.meaning: The Immaculate Conception means that God kept Mary free from original sin from the very first moment of her life, when she began to grow inside her mother.

kids.draw: Draw the angel Gabriel visiting Mary in her home, with the words "full of grace" written above them.
kids.ask: Mary said yes to God. What is one thing God might be asking you to say yes to?

family.opener: Today is a holy day of obligation, when we celebrate that God kept Mary free from original sin from the very first moment of her life.
questions: In Genesis, Adam and Eve hide from God and blame each other. What do we tend to do when we have done something wrong?
Mary was troubled by the angel's words, but she still said yes. What helps us trust God when we do not understand?
Why do you think God prepared Mary so carefully to be the mother of Jesus?
family.try: Pray the Hail Mary together each day this week, and find the words of the angel in today's Gospel that begin the prayer.
family.pray: Holy Mary, conceived without sin, pray for our family, that like you we may say yes to God in everything.
